correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md blob 02bc2cf2. For W_c=C\{c}, a voter with approval-size r contributes 1 or 1-1/r to SAV, and H_r or H_(r-1)=H_r-1/r to PAV. Therefore SAV(W_c)=number_of_voters-s(c), PAV(W_c)=sum_i H_|A_i|-s(c), with s(c)=sum_{i:c approved}1/|A_i|, so ALL weak rankings/ties/winner sets coincide for nonempty ballots and m>=2. Independently tested exact rational identities on randomized approval profiles for m=2 through 7 and exhaustive direct ballot formula argument for arbitrary finite m. This is correct but only one harmonic-number decrement; it does not imply equivalence for other committee sizes.
